name: Online Love
source:
Online Love is a visual novel dating sim that actually uses a dating app/personality test kind of thing in the game to cater to the player's actual interests and personality in real life. 
[From [url=https://richardjaey.itch.io/online-love] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Online Love是一款视觉小说约会模拟游戏，实际上在游戏中使用约会应用程序/性格测试之类的东西来迎合玩家在现实生活中的实际兴趣和性格。
[来自[url=https://richardjaey.itch.io/online-love] itch.io[/url]]
